App.Name: Bilibili MetroUI Revamped Edition
App.Description: Bilibili is a well-known Chinese video sharing and interaction platform, often called "B Site." It originated from ACG (anime, comic, and games) culture, initially focusing on animation, comics, and games, and gradually expanded into diverse fields such as music, dance, technology, lifestyle, and education. Users can not only watch videos but also interact with other viewers in real time through danmaku (bullet comments), forming a unique community atmosphere. Bilibili also released a client on the Windows 8 platform, supporting HD video playback, danmaku features, and account synchronization, allowing users to enjoy an experience consistent with mobile on PC. It is not only an entertainment platform but also a gathering place for young people to communicate and create.

App.Name: SkyDrive Metro
App.Description: SkyDrive is an important cloud storage app in Windows 8. It provides users with convenient file synchronization and sharing features, allowing documents, photos, and videos to be accessed anytime and anywhere. Through deep integration with the operating system, users can seamlessly switch between desktop, tablet, and phone while keeping data consistent. SkyDrive supports automatic backup, ensuring data is safe and reliable, and also makes it easy to share files with friends or colleagues, improving collaboration efficiency. The interface is simple and intuitive, and the operation is smooth, in line with the modern style of Windows 8. It is not only a storage tool but also a bridge connecting work and life, bringing efficiency and convenience.

App.Name: Blue Ghost Weather (Pro Edition)
App.Description: Blue Ghost Weather provides precipitation forecasts and real-time radar maps. The interface supports multiple cities, 3-day trend forecasts, and air quality monitoring. Interactive maps, cloud cover, and other layers. Compared with mobile, visualization is clearer and operation is more efficient, suitable for professional weather monitoring and in-depth analysis.

App.Name: Music Hub
App.Description: Listen to millions of songs and podcasts for free.

App.Name: Fire Music
App.Description: Listen to millions of songs and podcasts for free.

App.Name: Asphalt 8: Airborne
App.Description: Asphalt 8: Airborne is an extremely popular racing game on the Windows 8 platform. With high-speed racing and cool stunts as its core gameplay, players can drive various luxury sports cars and experience extreme speed on tracks around the world. The game has beautiful graphics and realistic physics, supporting drifting, jumping, and aerial stunts, bringing a stunning visual and operational experience. Through multiplayer mode, players can also compete in real time with friends or global players, adding competitive fun. Asphalt 8 is not just a racing game but a symbol of speed and passion, fully demonstrating the entertainment charm of the Windows 8 platform.

App.Name: Melegram Web
App.Description: This is a Windows 8.1 Telegram web app based on mpgram! Telegram (also known as Telegram Messenger) is a cloud-based cross-platform social media and instant messaging (IM) service. It was released for iOS on August 14, 2013, and for Android on October 20, 2013. Users can exchange messages, share media and files, make private and group voice or video calls, and public livestreams through Telegram. Telegram supports Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, Wear OS, watchOS, and web browsers. Telegram provides end-to-end encryption in voice and video calls, and optionally in private chats if both parties use mobile devices. Telegram also has social networking features, allowing users to post updates, create public groups with up to 200,000 members, and share updates one-way to unlimited audiences in so-called "channels."

App.Name: ITHome
App.Description: ITHome is a client on the Windows 8 platform focused on IT news and technology information. It provides users with the latest industry trends, product reviews, technical articles, and hot topics, allowing tech enthusiasts to stay informed at the first opportunity. The app interface adopts the modern style of Windows 8 and supports tile display, allowing users to quickly browse news summaries on the Start screen. Through category browsing and search functions, users can easily find content they are interested in. ITHome is not only a news reading tool but also a bridge connecting developers, users, and the industry, helping everyone maintain a cutting-edge perspective and efficiently obtain information in the information age.

App.Name: Microsoft Treasure Hunt
App.Description: Microsoft Treasure Hunt is a free puzzle adventure game developed by Microsoft Studios, with core gameplay built on classic Minesweeper. In the game, players take on the role of an explorer venturing into underground mazes in search of wealth. The game combines classic Minesweeper logic with RPG elements: players must mark suspicious terrain based on number clues, carefully plan each step to avoid traps, and collect coins, tools, and weapons. Using collected coins, players can also buy supplies and permanent upgrades in shops to aid their journey to the center of the Earth. The game supports Xbox Live integration, allowing players to earn achievements and compete with friends on leaderboards, with progress saved in the cloud.

App.Name: Simple Solitaire
App.Description: Simple Solitaire is a classic card game developed by Random Salad Games, focusing on pure Klondike gameplay. The game offers both draw-one and draw-three modes, and supports standard scoring and Vegas scoring rules. Operation is easy, with unlimited hints and undo. In addition, players can customize backgrounds and card back designs. The game requires no account registration and has no forced in-app purchases. It is completely free to download, striving to restore the pure fun of the classic computer card game.

App.Name: Dailymotion
App.Description: Dailymotion is a globally popular video sharing app offering a massive amount of original content covering news, music, sports, entertainment, and more. Unlike algorithms that chase view counts, it focuses more on creating a community interaction atmosphere, allowing users to communicate in real time around videos. The app offers personalized recommendations, bookmarking, and offline viewing, making it convenient to enjoy videos anytime and anywhere. In addition, creators can use professional tools such as green screen and layered editing to edit and upload content. The app supports cross-platform use (iOS 16.0 and above, Android 5.0 and above) and offers a subscription service, Dailymotion Pass, to unlock more benefits.

App.Name: Simple Spider Solitaire
App.Description: Simple Spider Solitaire is a classic card game developed by Random Salad Games, perfectly recreating the Spider Solitaire experience built into Windows. The game loads quickly and is completely free, offering 1-suit, 2-suit, and 4-suit modes, as well as classic 10-column and mini 8-column layouts, meeting different difficulty needs. The game features unlimited hints and undo, making it easy for beginners to get started. In addition, it supports custom backgrounds and card back designs, allowing players to create a personalized game style.

App.Name: Texas Holdem Poker
App.Description: Texas Holdem Poker is an online Texas Hold'em game developed by HytoGame, previously released on Windows 10 and Windows Phone platforms. The game focuses on high-quality interface design and premium multiplayer battle experience. Players can compete with users worldwide, and real-time online chat between players is supported. In addition to core gameplay, the game also features a rich customization system, including multiple HD avatars and hundreds of entertainment items. The game adopts a free download plus in-app purchase model, with in-app purchase prices ranging from $1.99 to $99.99. The app supports multiple languages including Chinese and English, with copyright marked as © 2013 HytoGame.

App.Name: 3rd Floor Blackjack
App.Description: 3rd Floor Blackjack is a free blackjack game developed by 3rd Floor Games. The game features the following highlights: Four unique themed tables: each table has its own style and gameplay. Exciting side bets: multiple side bet options are offered, adding more strategy and fun to the game. Achievement collection system: earn achievements by completing different challenges and improve your skills. Win tokens to unlock content: players can unlock new side bets and tables by winning tokens, increasing replayability. Completely free: the game is free to download and play. Online leaderboards: compete with players worldwide. The game was released by 3rd Floor Games in September 2013 and is a free single-player casual game built for the Windows platform.

App.Name: Texas Holdem Poker (Premium Edition)
App.Description: Texas Holdem Poker Plus is an online Texas Hold'em game developed by HytoGame, previously released on Windows 10 and Windows Phone platforms. The game focuses on high-quality interface design and premium multiplayer battle experience. Players can compete with users worldwide, and real-time online chat between players is supported. In addition to core gameplay, the game also features a rich customization system, including multiple HD avatars and hundreds of entertainment items. The game adopts a free download plus in-app purchase model, with in-app purchase prices ranging from $1.99 to $99.99. The app supports multiple languages including Chinese and English, with copyright marked as © 2013 HytoGame.

App.Name: Mafia City Grand Theft Mission
App.Description: Mafia City Grand Crime Mission or Mafia City Grand Theft Mission, developed by UK Arts Games. This is a free 3D action-adventure game in a style similar to GTA. Players play as gangsters completing various criminal missions in cities such as Miami, Las Vegas, and San Andreas, including street shootouts, bank robberies, and evading police pursuits.

App.Name: FarmVille 2: Country Escape
App.Description: FarmVille 2: Country Escape is a free simulation management mobile game developed by Zynga and is the mobile installment of the classic farm game FarmVille series. Released in 2014, it supports iOS and Android platforms and includes multiple languages including Chinese. The core gameplay revolves around running a farm: players plant crops, raise animals (such as cows, chickens, and horses), harvest ingredients, and then craft various goods in processing facilities such as dairies and ovens. Completing orders earns coins and experience, gradually leveling up and unlocking new content. The game also features special areas such as "Papa's Pond" and "Merriweather Mine" for players to explore and collect rare materials. In terms of social features, players can join "Farm Co-ops," trade with friends or other players, help each other complete tasks, or choose "Anonymous Mode" to play alone. The game supports offline mode, allowing core operations such as planting and harvesting even without an internet connection. The game is free to download and includes in-app purchases, but player feedback indicates a good experience without paying.

App.Name: Monster Go!
App.Description: Monster Go! is a side-scrolling endless runner with RPG elements published by Game Troopers. The game was first exclusively released on Windows Phone in May 2015, with iOS and Android versions planned afterward. The core gameplay is controlling a little monster running through levels, continuously growing and strengthening the character. Main features include: Choose an initial monster: three different monsters with different skills and styles are available for players to choose from. Rich progression system: supports upgrading more than 10 active and passive skills and allows monsters to evolve into stronger forms. Massive equipment combinations: over 150 weapons, armor, and accessories to collect and equip. Multiple game modes: players can challenge 5 different levels and 5 powerful bosses, and unlock endless mode after clearing. Xbox Live integration: the game includes many Xbox achievements, totaling 300G of achievement points.

App.Name: Imperia Online: The Great People
App.Description: Imperia Online: The Great People is a massively multiplayer online strategy game (MMO) published by developer Game Troopers. The original game was developed by Bulgarian studio Imperia Online Ltd, first launched in 2005, and later brought to the Windows platform by Game Troopers in 2015 with Xbox Live integration. The game is set in the Cold Weapons era before the invention of gunpowder. Players play as an emperor, starting from managing a province and gradually expanding territory by building resource structures, researching technology, and recruiting armies, ultimately establishing a powerful empire. Core features include: The "Great People" system: players can establish their own royal dynasty, manage royal family members, appoint them as governors or generals, and gain corresponding administrative or military bonuses. Deep strategy and social gameplay: players can attack other players' provinces to plunder resources, or establish or join alliances for military and economic cooperation. Xbox Live support: the game includes multiple Xbox achievements for players to unlock. In the Windows 10 version, it also has exclusive 3D battle visuals and an optimized user interface.

App.Name: eBay
App.Description: eBay officially released a Metro-style app for Windows 8, using live tiles and sharing features to provide a convenient shopping experience. However, the app ceased service in 2016 and was removed from the Store, with the company recommending users switch to mobile browsers to access the website. Since then, Microsoft Store has not released a new eBay client. Today, Windows users can only use eBay through the web, which is fully functional but lacks the smoothness and system integration of a native app. The disappearance of this app also reflects the broader decline of the Windows Phone ecosystem and eBay's readjustment of its mobile strategy.

App.Name: Super Photo Free
App.Description: SuperPhoto is a photo editing app released by developer Moonlighting, and its Windows 8 version was once available for download in the Windows Store. The software's selling point is its rich effects library. The free version includes over 300 effects, and paid upgrades unlock more than 1,500 filters and effects. Features cover artistic style conversion (such as painting, pencil sketch, and cartoon effects), fun frames (which can embed photos into T-shirts, TVs, and banknotes), as well as shape overlays, mosaics, and 3D rotation for creative editing. The app is compatible with Windows 8 and 8.1.

App.Name: Fhotoroom Photo Editor
App.Description: Fhotoroom is a photo editing and sharing app developed by Supporting Computers Inc, designed specifically for Windows 8 tablets and phones. It was praised by PCMag as adding powerful editing tools on top of the Instagram model, even surpassing it in some respects. The app offers rich filters and effects and has an active photo-sharing community with millions of users. Unlike the mobile version, the Windows 8 tablet version of Fhotoroom does not have a built-in camera but supports processing RAW format files from professional cameras and offers more powerful "Pro Tools" professional editing tools, such as noise reduction and local adjustment brushes. The app is free and can be used as a photo editor without registration.

App.Name: Spin Wheel
App.Description: A spinning wheel game made by a Polish developer.

App.Name: Twitter Tweetium
App.Description: Tweetium is a third-party Twitter client developed by B-side Software and was once hailed as one of the best Twitter apps on Windows 8.1 and Windows Phone. It was known for its smooth interface, rich features, and multi-account management, supporting real-time tweet streams, push notifications, and TweetMarker synchronization. The app used a free trial plus Pro subscription model. However, in 2018 Twitter adjusted its API strategy and discontinued the user stream API, causing push notifications to fail, and B-side immediately stopped its Pro subscription service. In early 2023, Twitter essentially closed third-party API access, making Tweetium completely unusable, becoming a classic regret in the platform ecosystem's changes.

App.Name: Microsoft Jigsaw
App.Description: Microsoft Jigsaw is an official puzzle game from Microsoft, officially launched on the Windows 8.1 Store in 2014 and also runnable on Windows RT and Windows 10. It is a free app that supports both keyboard/mouse and touchscreen input. The game offers three core modes: Classic Jigsaw: the traditional puzzle mode, with hundreds of high-definition images built in and support for 4 difficulty levels, up to 216 pieces. Jigsaw Jam: a timed challenge mode requiring players to quickly find the correct position within a countdown to earn score bonuses. Daily Challenges: new puzzle tasks updated every day, accumulating monthly badges. A major feature of the game is support for custom puzzles, allowing players to upload their own photos from the device to generate unique puzzles. In addition, it integrates Xbox Live features, allowing players to sign in to earn achievements, participate in leaderboards, and save game progress in the cloud. It is worth noting that the app was briefly listed and then quickly removed in the early days after release, but it soon returned. According to player feedback, when running on Windows 8, there were also cases where system updates caused the app to fail to open properly.

App.Name: House of Fun
App.Description: House of Fun is a free casino-style slots game developed by Playtika UK – House of Fun Limited. It was once available on the Windows 8 platform, but its main platforms are currently iOS and Android, requiring an emulator to play on PC. The game offers a massive selection of slots and a deep system: Rich slots library: over 400 slots built in, covering retro three-reel classics and modern video slots with wilds, scatters, and multi-stage bonus rounds. Deep collection system: each spin can collect card packs containing cards of different rarities. Completing themed albums can be exchanged for coin rewards, and duplicate cards can be traded in the Starlight Market for continuous income. Diverse reward mechanisms: daily login grants free coin gifts and a spin of the "Wheel of Fun," and the game also features frequent jackpot opportunities and special challenge events. Playtika Rewards program: the game is connected to the broader Playtika loyalty program, and points earned from playing can be exchanged for benefits and coin rewards in multiple games under the brand. The game is intended for adults aged 21 and above and is purely a free entertainment app with no real-money gambling or real-world prizes.

App.Name: Microsoft Minesweeper
App.Description: In the Windows 8 era, the classic Minesweeper underwent an important innovation. It was no longer a built-in system game but became a free app that needed to be downloaded from the Windows Store, developed by Arkadium in cooperation with Microsoft and published by Microsoft Studios. This new game, called Microsoft Minesweeper, retained the classic logic gameplay while receiving a comprehensive upgrade. It mainly brought the following changes: Brand-new visuals and controls: the game's graphics and sound effects were improved, and touchscreen operation was optimized, making it smoother to play on tablets and other devices. Added new game modes: in addition to the familiar "Classic Mode," "Adventure Mode" and "Daily Challenges" were added. In Adventure Mode, you need to control a character and use Minesweeper rules to explore and hunt for treasure. Integrated Xbox Live features: supports signing in with an Xbox account to earn achievements, view leaderboards, and save game progress in the cloud.

App.Name: Microsoft Solitaire Collection
App.Description: Microsoft Solitaire Collection is a classic card game launched by Microsoft with Windows 8 in 2012, developed by Arkadium. It integrates five gameplay modes—Klondike, Spider Solitaire, FreeCell, Pyramid, and TriPeaks—into one, marking the first time Pyramid and TriPeaks were included in the main collection. The game uses a free plus ads model and is deeply integrated with Xbox Live, supporting achievements, leaderboards, and cloud progress synchronization. The newly added Daily Challenges and Star Club system enhance replayability, and rich themes and backgrounds also allow personalization. This app replaced the built-in system Solitaire and became the new benchmark for card games on the Windows platform, and it is still continuously updated today.

App.Name: Croc's World
App.Description: Croc's World is a platformer developed by Sprakelsoft GmbH, launched around 2014 on Windows 8 and Windows Phone platforms. The game uses a retro art style similar to Super Mario and tells the adventure of a little crocodile. Its content includes 60 levels across four different themed worlds, where players must avoid enemies such as hedgehogs and bees and collect diamonds to earn extra lives. The game was designed for Windows 8 and 8.1 systems, and later derivative works such as Croc's World Construction Kit were also released.

App.Name: Crossy Road
App.Description: Crossy Road is a classic endless runner developed by Hipster Whale, with its Windows 8 version released in 2015. The game uses a retro pixel style, and the gameplay is simple but addictive—players must control a character continuously crossing busy roads, railways, and rivers, avoiding obstacles such as vehicles, and striving to go farther. The game also has a unique version on Windows, namely Disney Crossy Road, jointly released by Disney and Hipster Whale, also supporting Windows 8 and 8.1. That version offers over 100 characters from Disney and Pixar and includes pixel worlds themed after classics such as Toy Story and The Lion King.

App.Name: QQ
App.Description: QQ is a QQ client developed by Tencent specifically for the Windows 8 Metro interface. It uses a UWP architecture and was launched on the app store on February 29, 2012, as China's first Win8 app. It uses dynamic backgrounds and a left-right layout, adapting to both touch and keyboard/mouse operation. Core features include text and emoji sending, voice messages, offline file transfer, and Qzone feed previews, and it supports split-screen view. Early versions had many bugs and were optimized multiple times for login stability and crash issues. This version does not support simultaneous multi-account login and is mutually exclusive with PC QQ.

App.Name: Reddit Client (Charming Reddit)
App.Description: Charming Reddit is a Reddit client on Windows 8 focused on image browsing, with an interface similar to a gallery app, allowing users to clearly see thumbnails, descriptions, comment counts, and vote counts. It deeply integrates the Windows 8 Charms Bar: users can log in to their account through the "Settings" charm and share content with others through the "Share" charm. The app defaults to opening /r/pics/ and can switch to view other popular subreddits, supporting sorting by hot, top, or new.

App.Name: Weather Forecast AccuWeather
App.Description: AccuWeather for Windows 8 is an immersive weather app officially released by AccuWeather, launched with Windows 8 in October 2012. The app uses the new Windows UI design and has rich dynamic weather animations that intuitively display current weather conditions. The app supports accurate forecasts for more than 2.7 million locations worldwide, providing hourly, 72-hour, and 25-day detailed forecasts. Its core features include: real-time updated weather data (including RealFeel temperature), interactive Bing Maps radar layers, and My AccuWeather lifestyle forecasts that show how weather affects health and outdoor activities. The app is completely free to download and supports automatic live tile refresh. A 2014 update added MinuteCast minute-by-minute precipitation forecasts and transitioned to a universal app.

App.Name: Lenovo Power DVD
App.Description: PowerDVD for Windows 8 was released by CyberLink and includes two versions: PowerDVD 12 and PowerDVD Mobile. This app mainly fills the gap after the Windows 8 system removed native DVD playback support, allowing users to continue playing DVDs, Blu-ray discs, and various video files. PowerDVD Mobile is optimized for Windows 8 tablets, with a touch-adapted interface, supporting playback of videos, music, and photos. The app interface displays content as a media library, is powerful, and is regarded as one of the essential playback software options on Windows 8.

App.Name: Your Camera YouCam Metro Lenovo
App.Description: YouCam for Windows 8 is a camera app released by CyberLink, optimized for touch devices. The app mainly includes two versions: YouCam Metro Beta, an early Metro version supporting real-time fun effects and TrueTheater Lighting one-click enhancement; and YouCam Mobile, which provides advanced features for mobile devices such as face recognition, automatic group management, deformation animation effects, and noise reduction. The app deeply integrates Windows 8 touch features, and captured content can be shared directly to YouTube or Facebook. The app supports Windows 8 and 8.1 systems. Although it was later removed from the Store, CyberLink still provides desktop YouCam software for Windows 10 users.

App.Name: Merriam-Webster Dictionary
App.Description: The official Merriam-Webster dictionary app launched simultaneously with Windows 8 in October 2012 and was regarded as "an important reference tool for Windows 8." The app integrates the full authoritative definitions of Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary and includes a built-in thesaurus, example sentences, audio pronunciations, over 1,000 illustrations, and 20,000 biographical and geographical entries. The app is specially optimized for touch interfaces and supports voice search, word of the day, favorites, and query history. The app is free to download, supported by ads, and can be used offline for word lookups.

App.Name: Lenovo Support (OEM)
App.Description: Lenovo OEM application.

App.Name: Lenovo Companion
App.Description: Lenovo OEM application.

App.Name: Happy Fisherman
App.Description: Fishing Joy had multiple related versions in the Windows 8 era. A fishing game called Happy Fisherman launched on the Win8 app store in 2013, with simple operation and gorgeous interface, supporting online rankings and an achievement system. In addition, Fishing Diary, Fishing Joy developed by Dong Tran is also compatible with Windows 8.1/8 systems and is a free shooting fishing game where players earn coins and rewards by hunting fish. Another game called Fishing Master 2017 also supports Win8.

App.Name: Jungle Adventure
App.Description: A puzzle game suitable for children.

App.Name: Magic Dressup
App.Description: A game suitable for children.

App.Name: Encyclopaedia Britannica
App.Description: Encyclopaedia Britannica officially launched its Windows 8 app on October 26, 2012, the same day the Windows 8 system was released. This app is a digital version of Encyclopaedia Britannica, containing more than 80,000 articles and tens of thousands of high-definition images, with content written by experts and scholars. The app is optimized for Windows 8 touch operation and has a unique visual related browsing feature—Link Map—which displays connections between related entries in a node graph format. The app supports search, bookmarks, saving articles, and pinning to the Start screen. The app is free to download; the free version allows reading "Featured Articles" and the daily featured article, but most articles can only preview the first 100 words. To unlock all content, an annual subscription of $14.99 is required.

App.Name: Lenovo Free Ride Games
App.Description: Lenovo exclusive application.

App.Name: Free Online Movies Free Edition
App.Description: This app was extracted from a Lenovo OEM Windows 8 laptop but is outdated.

App.Name: McAfee Security Advisor
App.Description: McAfee Security Advisor is an app designed specifically for Windows 8, appearing as a separate live tile on the Start screen. Its main purpose is to provide an entry point into the McAfee security system, allowing you to quickly check your computer's security status. This app is separate from McAfee antivirus software itself and does not provide virus or malware protection. You can think of it as a status display: the tile intuitively shows the current security level through green (protected), red (at risk), or gray (inactive), and clicking it shows more detailed status descriptions and conveniently opens the main program to fix issues. However, this app did not have a great reputation on Windows 8, with users often complaining about issues such as failure to properly display status information, and some even regarded it as unwanted "bloatware."

App.Name: Red Karaoke
App.Description: Red Karaoke is a popular free online karaoke app on Windows 8, providing a platform to sing and showcase yourself on your computer anytime and anywhere. The app's biggest highlight is its massive library of over 45,000 songs, covering music types from classic oldies to modern pop, rock, R&B, and more. You can search by artist name or song title. The app includes practical singing assistance features, such as scrolling lyrics with beat prompts while the music plays, and supports pitch adjustment to match your voice. Red Karaoke is not just a singing app; it also encourages users to record and share their performances, forming an active global community. The community has over 3 million users, and you can watch, comment on, and rate others' works. The app offers 10 songs per month for free, and purchasing or a VIP subscription unlocks the full library.

App.Name: YouSendIt
App.Description: Lenovo OEM app.

App.Name: Zinio
App.Description: Zinio for Windows 8 is a digital magazine reading app that was once regarded as one of the best magazine reading software for Windows 8, offering access to more than 5,000 magazines, including famous publications such as National Geographic, Vogue, and The Economist. The app is optimized for Win8, supporting high-resolution reading, touch zooming, offline downloads, and pinning content to the Start screen. The app is free to download, but reading full content requires a paid subscription or purchasing individual magazines. However, the app has officially stopped support and no longer provides new magazine updates.

App.Name: Afterlight
App.Description: Afterlight is a popular photo editing app, with its Windows 8.1 version launched in 2015. It is not a game but provides professional-grade retouching tools. The app includes 57 filters, 66 textures, 79 frames, and 8 basic adjustment tools such as brightness and saturation, and also integrates camera and cropping features. The app is a paid download, priced at about $0.99/€0.99, and a trial version is also available.

App.Name: VK
App.Description: VK's (Vkontakte) official Windows 8 app was once available on the Windows Store, providing social services for users in Russia and other Russian-speaking regions. The app is optimized for touch and supports live tiles in various sizes and split-screen view. After the release of Windows 8.1 in 2013, the app was redesigned, adding feedback features, English and Ukrainian language support, and integrating Bing Maps and Yandex Maps. However, the app's features were relatively basic, and messaging required a separate app. As VK abandoned support for Windows 8, this version has stopped updating, and users need to use the web version or upgrade their system.

App.Name: PhotoFunia
App.Description: PhotoFunia once released a free Windows 8 app that lets users easily create fun photo composites. It uses cloud technology to automatically recognize faces and blend photos into hundreds of special effect scenes such as billboards and magazine covers, with simple operation and realistic results. The app is optimized for the Windows 8 touch interface and is smooth to use. In magazine reviews at the time, it received a high rating of 4.5 stars out of 5.

App.Name: JD.com
App.Description: JD.com launched a Windows 8-specific client in November 2012, making it one of the first domestic e-commerce apps to support the Win8 system. The app uses the "Windows 8 Style" (Metro) design language and is optimized for touch devices. Core features include product browsing, ordering, order tracking, product category search, and featured "flash sales" and "browse casually" (intelligent product recommendations based on shopping habits). The app supports pinning pages such as "My JD" and "Order Tracking" to the Start screen for quick access. According to reviews at the time, the app had relatively rich product information, but there was still room for improvement in interface design details and the shopping process experience, and payment still required jumping to the web.

App.Name: Windows 93 (Unofficial)
App.Description: Windows 93 is not an operating system officially released by Microsoft but a famous web art project and parody. It is a web desktop that can be experienced by visiting windows93.net in a browser. The project was created in 2014 by two French musicians and programmers, jankenpopp and Zombectro, as a playful parody of the Windows 9x series. This web operating system is full of references to internet memes and pop culture from the late 1990s and early 2000s. It plays a startup sound imitating classic operating systems when launched (actually sampled from PlayStation). It contains a large number of interactive applications, such as: Parody games: Castle GAFA 3D, a parody of Wolfenstein 3D, and KOF '93, imitating Street Fighter. Classic and creative tools: a text editor, pixel art editor, ASCII art gallery, MIDI music player, and even a "virtual machine" that can open another Windows 93 inside the current window. Windows 93 quickly became popular after its birth, attracting millions of users in just two weeks. It was included in exhibitions by French cultural institutions and is regarded as a representative work in the field of digital culture.

App.Name: Minecraft Windows 8
App.Description: This game is mainly aimed at Windows 8 and includes Survival and Creative modes. This version stopped receiving updates in 2015 because player activity on Windows 8 was too low. Some users reported compatibility issues when playing on Windows 8 and suggested upgrading the system or installing specific drivers to resolve them.

App.Name: Windows Central
App.Description: The official Windows Central Windows 8 app is a third-party news client for reading content from the Windows Central website (formerly WPCentral). The app is free to download and ad-supported. It is optimized for touch operation and supports live tiles showing the latest articles, comment interaction, and offline reading. The app offers personalization options such as adjustable font styles and sizes and multicolor themes. The development team actively collected user feedback and continuously updated to fix bugs and improve the experience. The app later also released a version adapted for Windows 10.

App.Name: Aito Web Browser
App.Description: The developer of AITO Web Browser, chockingnetdude, is a community developer specializing in apps for older electronic devices (such as Windows 8/8.1 and Windows Phone 7/8/10). This browser is one of his multiple projects, all working together to revive the app ecosystem of these old platforms.

App.Name: Google Search Revival Edition
App.Description: Google Search was Google's first official app for Windows 8, launched in October 2012. The app deeply integrates Google's core search services, offering voice search, image search, and instant preview mode, and supports quick invocation through the Charm bar. The app supports integrating quick access to Google services such as Gmail and YouTube in one place. The app is free to download but was not available for Windows RT devices at the time.

App.Name: Amazon
App.Description: Amazon once released an official shopping app when Windows 8 was launched, supporting direct search, browsing, and purchase of products in the Modern interface. The app was compatible with x86/x64 Windows 8 and Windows RT devices and supported features such as live tiles and wish lists. At the time, this app and the Kindle for Windows 8 reading app together formed Amazon's main products on the Win8 platform. However, Amazon later adjusted its strategy. It removed the Kindle for Windows 8 app from the Store in 2016 and focused on maintaining the traditional Win32 Kindle for PC app. Currently, the Microsoft Store no longer offers the official Amazon Shopping app, and users can only access the Amazon website through a browser.

App.Name: Reuters
App.Description: Reuters once released an official news app for Windows 8 and 8.1 in 2014, available for free download from the Windows Store. The app provides professional-grade news content from this top global news agency, covering international, business, politics, technology, entertainment, and more, and includes high-quality images and videos. The app interface uses the typical horizontal layout of Windows 8, with a clear and concise design, and supports sharing articles to social networks. Its main limitation was that initially only US and UK versions were provided, although a Chinese-language version called "Reuters Mobile" existed, offering Chinese financial news. The app also supports offline reading of articles.

App.Name: ING Bankiren
App.Description: ING released an official mobile banking app (Mobiel Bankieren App) for Windows 8 and Windows Phone platforms in June 2013. The app was developed by ING in cooperation with Capgemini and Microsoft, using a new multi-platform architecture that allows it to run smoothly on touch devices. The app has basic banking functions, including checking account balances and making transfers. The app uses the Modern design style of Windows 8, with a simple and refreshing interface, and supports the "Snap View" feature, making it convenient for multitasking. Users can download it for free from the Windows Store.

App.Name: Karaoke One
App.Description: Karaoke One is a free karaoke app developed by Italian company Lisari s.r.l. and was once described as the first "mobile talent show." It is a UWP app that was initially very popular on Windows 8 and Windows Phone and later also released on Xbox One, allowing users to sing with friends in the living room. The app's core is to let users sing thousands of high-quality songs with synchronized lyrics, record and share their performance videos and audio to social networks or the in-app community. Its song catalog is very international, covering genres from pop and rock to hip-hop, and is updated weekly, featuring contemporary hits from artists such as Adele and Ed Sheeran as well as classics from legends such as Queen and Michael Jackson. In terms of community interaction, users can like and comment on others' performances, build their own fan base, and even compete for weekly or monthly rankings to become "Karaoke King or Queen of the Week." In-app social feedback features such as "You Rock" reactions further enhance the fun of interaction. The app itself is free to download, but its core business model is in-app purchases and subscriptions. Users can unlock the entire song catalog through subscription and enjoy an ad-free and HD experience, with frequent promotional discounts. The app is still being updated, with the latest version being 6.6.11.0 released in February 2026.

App.Name: Storm of Wars - Sacred Homeland
App.Description: Storm of Wars - Sacred Homeland is a free massively multiplayer online real-time strategy game (MMORTS) released by developer Ocous. Platform and system requirements: The game was originally designed for Windows 8.1 / Windows Phone 8.1 and above and once ranked first in the Windows Store indie strategy category. It also has Android and iOS versions, so it can also be played on PC through an Android emulator. Core gameplay: The game combines kingdom building and real-time strategy gameplay, including fast-paced battles in cities and epic wars on the world map. Players can choose one of four factions, build cities, summon heroes, and form guilds with other players to compete on a vast global map.

App.Name: Rolling Slots (Pro)
App.Description: Slots Pro is a free slots game released by developer Rolling Donut Apps. It is designed for Windows 8.1 and above, aiming to provide a Las Vegas-style slots entertainment experience. The game offers three featured slots with unique mini-games and includes daily rewards, progressive jackpots, and global leaderboards. This game and other titles from the developer such as Jewel Star have used methods such as video ads to increase ad revenue and user engagement.

App.Name: IM+
App.Description: IM+ for Windows 8 is a free instant messaging aggregation app developed by SHAPE GmbH. It was launched alongside the Windows 8 system and was hailed as one of the best IM software at the time. Its biggest highlight is the ability to integrate up to 19 different chat services in one interface, including Windows Live Messenger, Skype, Facebook, Google Talk, AOL, Yahoo!, ICQ, VKontakte, and more. The app is optimized for touch and supports split-screen view, lock screen notifications, and custom backgrounds. It offers an ad-free Pro paid version ($4.99), while the free version meets most needs.

App.Name: Royal Revolt 2
App.Description: Royal Revolt 2 does have a Windows 8 version, developed by German game company flaregames. The game launched on Windows 8 and Windows Phone 8 platforms in 2014 and is a free-to-download, in-app-purchase "reverse tower defense" strategy game where players build castles and attack other players. Regarding the Win8 version of this game, there are several key points worth noting: It was once an important revenue source for the developer: around 2015, the Windows platform (including Win8 and WP8.1) contributed more than one-third of the game's revenue, and mobile revenue even doubled. System requirements and subsequent support: The game officially supports Windows 8.1 and above. However, Store support for the Windows 8.1 version has ended, and the official announcement in 2023 stated that updates for that version would no longer be provided, in-app purchases would gradually be disabled, and players were advised to migrate their accounts to Windows 10 or higher.

App.Name: Foreca Weather
App.Description: Foreca Weather is a free weather app developed by Foreca Ltd. and once had versions for Windows 8 and 8.1. The app provides 10-day weather forecasts for more than 140,000 locations worldwide and includes dynamic weather maps. One of its features is high accuracy; Foreca itself is also one of the data providers for Microsoft's built-in Windows weather app. However, older versions of this app later had issues opening on Windows 8.1, and the official recommendation is now to use its web version or the UWP version designed for Windows 10/11.

App.Name: Facebook Touch
App.Description: Windows 8 once had an official Facebook app. It launched alongside the Windows 8.1 update in October 2013 and was seen at the time as filling an important gap on the platform. This app was developed by Facebook itself, with an interface similar to the iPad version's three-column layout: left navigation, middle news feed, and right chat list. It was optimized for touch and supported the Share Charm for quick sharing and the Snap View split-screen mode in Windows 8.1. The app required Windows 8.1. It was free to download but had to be obtained from the Windows Store. Unfortunately, Facebook officially announced in March 2017 that it would stop supporting the Windows 8/8.1 version and officially ended service at the end of 2019. Therefore, the official Facebook app can no longer be used normally on Windows 8, and users can only access it through a web browser.

App.Name: Reddit ReddHub Client
App.Description: ReddHub is a well-known third-party Reddit client on Windows 8, created by developer Feras Moussa. It was widely praised for its smooth and efficient two-column browsing experience and was once described as "the most beautiful Reddit client." The app fully incorporates Windows 8 features, supports pinning subreddits to the Start screen, and deeply integrates the Share charm. When Windows 8.1 was updated, the developer also promptly followed up by adding support for more sizes in split-screen view, new extra-large live tiles, and in-app web navigation.

App.Name: Expedia
App.Description: Expedia once released an official hotel booking app in the early days of Windows 8. The app officially launched in December 2012 as part of Expedia's multi-platform strategy. This Windows 8 app mainly focused on hotel search and booking, allowing users to browse real-time prices and availability for more than 140,000 hotels worldwide. It used a simple touch interface, allowing filtering results by price, rating, or star level, and provided map views, images, and user reviews. The app also offered some exclusive "mobile-only discounts." However, the initial version did not support booking flights or rental cars. The app is likely no longer updated and cannot be used normally on Windows 8. Users are usually advised to book through the official website or other clients that support newer systems.

App.Name: Amazon Kindle
App.Description: Amazon once released an official Kindle app for Windows 8, but that history is now in the past. At the time, the app made full use of Windows 8 touch features and provided a complete reading environment. You could not only read e-books but also directly access the Kindle Store to purchase new books. It supported Whispersync technology, which could synchronize your reading progress, bookmarks, and notes across all devices. You could also pin favorite books to the Start screen or use split-screen for multitasking. However, Amazon removed the app from the Store in 2016 to focus on maintaining the more traditional "Kindle for PC" software. Therefore, for today's Windows 8 users, the historical chapter of the Kindle app has already turned.

App.Name: Pizza Hut
App.Description: Pizza Hut officially launched its Windows 8 app in 2013, developed through cooperation among Pizza Hut, Altaine, and Microsoft.

App.Name: Netflix
App.Description: Netflix officially released a dedicated app for Windows 8 in October 2012, launching simultaneously with the system release. The app is free to download and optimized for both touch and keyboard/mouse operation. The app incorporates the Modern UI style of Windows 8, supports sidebar swipe browsing and Semantic Zoom for an overview of the movie catalog. It can leverage the system's graphics acceleration to improve playback efficiency and reduce power consumption. The app also supports Snap View for multitasking. As Windows 8.1 support has ended, this old version can no longer be guaranteed to work properly. It is now generally recommended to use Netflix through a web browser or install the new app for Windows 10/11. On Windows 8, playback resolution can only reach standard definition (SD) at best.

App.Name: CNN
App.Description: CNN launched its official app for Windows 8 in early 2013. This app provided a free and smooth news reading platform under the Windows 8 Modern interface. App features: The design is intuitive. The homepage displays both important headlines and the latest news at the same time, and users can also filter reading by different sections such as "Tech" and "Politics." The "Video" area on the right allows watching news videos. Its iReport feature is also distinctive, allowing users to directly upload their own articles, photos, and videos to share what they see. Operation and experience: This app integrates well with Windows 8 features. For example, articles support sharing through the Charm bar, and the top right of the main interface also provides favorites and reading history. Its live tile refreshes in real time, letting you see the latest headlines without opening the app. It runs smoothly and received good reviews for its design. Final shutdown: Unfortunately, this Windows 8 version, like its Windows Phone version, has stopped being supported. The official recommendation is now to access its mobile website through a browser to get news content. Therefore, if you want to watch CNN on a computer, the most stable and reliable way now is to use a web browser directly.

App.Name: Sohu Video
App.Description: Sohu Video launched an official client in the early days of Windows 8, making it one of the first video platforms to enter the Microsoft app store. This app was developed entirely based on the Win8 Modern interface, using a color-block layout highly integrated with the system. The homepage displayed content by seven major sections such as news, TV series, and movies, with the featured image occupying the main screen area. The playback interface presented the video window and film information on the same screen, with intuitive and smooth operation. In 2014, Sohu Video further cooperated with Microsoft to release a new client, removing pre-roll ads, supporting ultra-clear and original quality, and adding features such as series subscription reminders and multi-use on one screen. This version received relatively high ratings in the Windows Store.

App.Name: Flipboard
App.Description: Flipboard is a personal magazine reading app that was highly praised on Windows 8.1. It officially launched with the Windows 8.1 update in November 2013 and was one of the most anticipated heavyweight apps on the platform at the time. The app fully incorporates Windows 8 features, supports live tiles and split-screen view, and makes it easy to pin specific magazines or content subscriptions to the Start screen. Users can connect social networks such as Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram to browse news, articles, and content shared by friends in a unified interface and create their own themed magazines. The app is specially optimized for touch operation, providing smooth page turning and gesture interaction.

App.Name: Hulu+
App.Description: Hulu launched the official Hulu Plus app simultaneously with the release of Windows 8 on October 26, 2012. This app is optimized for touch operation, uses a tile-style interface design that fits the Windows 8 style, and supports pinning favorite shows to the Start screen for one-click access. It also makes full use of the system's "Snap View" feature, allowing users to shrink the video to one side of the screen while doing other things. The subscription fee is $7.99 per month. The app later also came to Windows 10 as a Universal Windows Platform (UWP) app.

App.Name: MediaFire for Windows 8
App.Description: MediaFire Desktop for Windows 8 Software Overview: MediaFire Desktop is a desktop synchronization client officially launched by MediaFire in November 2013, providing file upload, synchronization, and sharing features. System compatibility: The software explicitly supports running on Windows 8. Free storage space: Registering a free account provides 10GB of initial storage space, which can be expanded up to 50GB through referrals and other methods. Main features: Supports drag-and-drop upload, screen capture and annotation, file link sharing, and sharing files to social platforms such as Facebook and Twitter. Subsequent support: The MediaFire desktop synchronization service stopped functioning on July 30, 2016. For later use on computers, the official recommendation was to switch to the web version. In March 2016, MediaFire released a Universal Windows Platform (UWP) version for Windows 10 and Windows 8.1, providing an alternative for newer systems.

App.Description: Surface hub for windows 8

App.Name: Newser
App.Description: Newser is a free news app released by Newser, LLC, which launched on the Windows 8 app store in August 2013. The app's core feature is "read less, know more": the editorial team selects the most important and engaging content from global news and compresses it into concise paragraphs for users. The app interface uses a unique visual grid layout for quickly browsing headlines. Newser also supports live tiles, which can display the number of unread stories and the latest headlines on the Start screen in real time. The app includes category channels such as "Latest," "Popular," "Headlines," "Great Finds," and "Politics," making it easy for users to filter reading. Users can vote on stories and choose emotion tags, and can also share content to social networks through the Charm bar. The app also supports Snap View and search. The app is free to download, with an installation package of only about 1.75 MB, using minimal system resources.

App.Name: The New York Times
App.Description: The New York Times officially released a dedicated app for Windows 8. The app launched simultaneously with the Windows 8 system on October 26, 2012. It was specially optimized for touch operation and adopted Win8-specific features such as live tiles (which can pin sections), edge-swipe navigation, and split-screen view. Subscribers could read all content including articles, videos, and blogs, while non-subscribers could only freely access the "Top News" section. The app also supported offline reading and cloud synchronization. Unfortunately, the app stopped being supported in 2016. The official recommendation at the time was for users to access nytimes.com through a web browser for a more complete reading experience.

App.Name: Tripadvisor
App.Description: TripAdvisor officially released a Windows 8.1 app in 2013. This app is optimized for touch operation and allows browsing more than 125 million traveler reviews worldwide, covering hotels, restaurants, and attractions. Deep integration with Bing Search: This is one of its biggest features. The app is deeply integrated with Windows 8.1's Bing Smart Search. When users search for related travel content, search results can directly display TripAdvisor hotel prices, ratings, and reviews, and clicking them jumps to the app for details without opening a browser. Complete practical features: The app integrates hotel price comparison, map positioning, and viewing "Travelers' Choice" award-winning hotels, and also supports logging in to write reviews and save places.

App.Name: The Weather Channel
App.Description: The Weather Channel official app launched on Windows 8 in late 2012. It underwent a major redesign in March 2013, fully updating the user interface and adding severe weather alerts, more real-time weather details (such as humidity and wind), and Bing Maps integration. The app also made full use of Windows 8 features, supporting live tiles to display weather information and lock screen notifications. Unfortunately, as official Windows 8 support ended in January 2018, the app was also removed from the Store in July of that year and finally stopped service in 2020. It can no longer be used normally on Windows 8 today.

App.Name: VLC Media Player
App.Description: VLC officially released a dedicated version for Windows 8. It was listed on the Windows Store in March 2014 and is a Modern-style app optimized for touch. This app continues the powerful cross-format playback capability of the desktop version, supporting MKV, FLAC, and many other mainstream audio and video formats. It also takes advantage of Windows 8 features such as live tiles and background playback, and can read files from external storage devices. However, the initial version had some limitations: it only supported x86/x64 Windows 8 and 8.1, did not support Windows RT devices, and early versions might be unstable on Win8.1.

2048 for Windows is a classic number puzzle game released by developer oneAssist on April 22, 2014. Its installation package is only about 201.57 KB, extremely small. The game supports adjustable boards from 4x4 to 7x7, with the highest target number settable up to 8192, and includes an endless mode. Operation is flexible, supporting keyboard, mouse, and touch swipe. Unlike NuonSoft's 2048 Pro, this version developed by oneAssist is a native Windows 8 app and was well liked by many users at the time for its high customization and minimalist design.

App.Description: ESPN officially released a news aggregation app and a WatchESPN live app for Windows 8. The news app supports real-time scores, myESPN personalized synchronization, and live tiles, and received a major update in July 2013. WatchESPN launched in February 2014 and required cable TV subscription login to unlock live channels. There were also specialized apps such as ESPN FC and ESPNcricinfo. Unfortunately, these official apps have long stopped being updated and supported, and now on Windows devices, users can only access the ESPN official website through a web browser to get news and live content.

App.Name: Hill Climb Racing
App.Description: Hill Climb Racing did have a Windows 8 version, produced by Finnish developer Fingersoft. This is a physics-based 2D racing game where players need to control a vehicle moving over various terrains while maintaining balance, avoiding rollovers, and not running out of fuel.

App.Name: Angry Birds Space
App.Description: Angry Birds Space is one of the first Xbox Live games officially released by Rovio on October 26, 2012, alongside the Windows 8 system. This game lets players launch birds in zero-gravity planetary environments to fight space pigs, featuring more than 130 interstellar levels and new bird abilities. The Windows 8 version deeply integrates Xbox Live features, supporting achievements and online leaderboards. It was priced at $4.99 and also offered a free trial version. The game entered the top paid apps after launching on the Windows Store. Unfortunately, Rovio stopped supporting the Microsoft Store version in December 2025, and it can no longer be obtained or played through official channels on Windows devices.

App.Name: Talking Ben
App.Description: Talking Ben is a classic interactive pet app developed by Outfit7. On the Windows 8 platform, this title was released as an official port on June 8, 2015. In the game, players first need to tap the newspaper to get retired chemistry professor Ben's attention, and then can talk to him, tickle him, or engage in various fun interactions. Featured gameplay includes lab mode, where test tubes can be mixed to observe chemical reactions. The app supports recording and sharing videos. Unfortunately, this version was removed from the Store at the end of 2018, and it can no longer be obtained through official channels on Windows devices.

App.Name: Disney Crossy Road
App.Description: Disney Crossy Road is an 8-bit style endless runner developed by Hipster Whale and published by Disney, released in April 2016 and officially launched on the Windows 8 platform. The game continues the classic gameplay of Crossy Road, where players must control characters continuously crossing roads, railways, and rivers while avoiding obstacles such as vehicles and trains. Its biggest feature is the inclusion of more than 100 Disney and Pixar characters and pixel worlds themed after Toy Story, The Lion King, and other classics. The game has now officially ceased operations on mainstream platforms such as iOS and Android, and no further updates will be released.

App.Name: Tonghuashun Stock Trading
App.Publisher: Zhejiang Hexin Tonghuashun Network Information Co., Ltd.
App.Description: Tonghuashun Stock Trading (300033), a stock trading software designed specifically for Windows 8 users. Tonghuashun stock trading software is currently the most widely used, most stable, supports the most brokers, and supports online trading free stock trading (financial) software in China. Tonghuashun Stock Trading lets you grasp market hotspots anytime and anywhere, make stock trading decisions easily, and place investment orders ahead of others!

App.Description: Can view weather and weather alerts.

App.Name: Tencent Tablet Manager
App.Publisher: Shenzhen Tencent Computer Systems Co., Ltd.
App.Description: Tencent Tablet Manager (For Windows 8) is completely free security and management software designed specifically for Windows 8 users. Adhering to the concept of "peace of mind, simplicity in action," it provides system cleaning, file encryption, system information viewing, and other features on Windows 8, making it your thoughtful Windows 8 device manager.

App.Name: Xunlei Kankan Player
App.Publisher: Shenzhen Xunlei Network Technology Co., Ltd.
App.Description: Xunlei Kankan Player supports many mainstream video formats such as RM, RMVB, XV, MKV, and FLV. As a new product redesigned specifically for the Windows Store, it inherits many features of the original desktop player, including comprehensive format support, good playback quality, smooth playback, and low resource consumption. Perfect format support, exquisite product design, Xunlei Kankan Player is committed to giving you a perfect viewing experience.

App.Name: China Merchants Bank
App.Description: China Merchants Bank has newly launched Win8 Tablet Banking, fully supporting Windows 8.0 and 8.1, bringing you a brand-new operating experience. Tailored for you, China Merchants Bank Win8 Tablet Banking provides the following featured services: ★ Zero fees for transfers and remittances: from now until the end of 2015, enjoy a daily transfer and remittance limit of up to 200,000 yuan (excluding agreement account transfers), with all fees waived! ★ Exclusive high-yield wealth management products, enjoy noble treatment! ★ Perfect support for Windows 8.0 and 8.1, clearer and smoother on large screens ★ Four major channel design, simple and easy to use, fully covering your financial life ★ Multiple security mechanisms, Win8 Tablet Banking is more reassuring.

App.Name: Ctrip Travel
App.Description: More favorable prices: no hidden service fees of any kind are charged, ensuring the most favorable room rates for you. More hotels: covering more than 3,000 large and medium-sized cities nationwide. Real guest reviews: experience reviews from 2 million real guests, trusted by 50 million loyal members. Lean service guarantee: 8,000 booking experts are always on standby, providing uninterrupted 7x24 service. Guaranteed room availability upon arrival: compensation commitment for the first night's room fee if no room is available upon arrival. Advantageous flight booking: 1 million low-price tickets available every day for you to choose from, 100% ticketing, safe and reliable. Whether on a journey or at a desk. Whether using a tablet or a PC, the Ctrip Travel app is your portable "travel assistant"!

App.Name: Youku HD
App.Publisher: HeYi Information Technology Beijing Co., Ltd.
App.Description: A video entertainment client product customized by Youku for Windows 8.1. Simple operation, in line with user habits. The Youku client has features such as online video playback, quick search, full-screen playback, and playback history recording, providing users with a more convenient client video playback experience.

App.Name: Chinese National Geography
App.Publisher: Beijing Panorama National Geographic New Media Technology Co., Ltd.
App.Description: This client app is the official client of Chinese National Geography, gathering the essence of four publications—Chinese National Geography, Natural History, Chinese Heritage, and Travel China—as well as series books published by Chinese National Geography. Adhering to the concept of "opening the door to nature, revealing the essence of humanity," it provides comprehensive read-as-you-go and read-as-you-like services based on LBS location positioning, making unfamiliar places no longer strange and allowing you to enjoy beautiful scenery around the world without leaving home. We are committed to building the most authoritative, practical, and in-depth high-end media app.

App.Name: My Talking Tom
App.Description: You can adopt a Tom cat, take care of him, interact with him, and he repeats what you say. Very fun.

App.Name: Fresh Paint
App.Description: You can create vivid digital drawings and paint oil paintings, sketches, watercolors, and more. Come download and create your artwork to your heart's content!

App.Name: Adobe Reader
App.Description: It can quickly open PDF files, make simple annotations, and can also be used to read e-books. Try it!

App.Name: Tencent Weibo
App.Publisher: Shenzhen Tencent Computer Systems Co., Ltd.
App.Description: A Tencent Weibo client built specifically for the Windows 8 platform. With a clean and refreshing interface and colorful content, it lets you share wonderful information and record life's moments with hundreds of millions of Weibo users anytime and anywhere.

App.Name: Youdao Dictionary
App.Publisher: Hangzhou NetEase Computer System Co., Ltd.
App.Description: Youdao Dictionary is a multilingual translation dictionary you carry with you. Its refined local Chinese-English vocabulary lets you enjoy free and fast local translation anytime and anywhere; word pronunciations, online definitions, and over 10 million example sentences bring you more detailed and authoritative query results through ubiquitous networks; the country's leading machine translation system provides instant free full-text translation services, helping you easily overcome language barriers no matter where you are; encyclopedia features also let you easily grasp related knowledge; the wordbook can synchronize in real time with the Youdao Dictionary desktop version or other platform clients, helping you easily learn words anytime and anywhere. Main features of the Windows 8.1 version of Youdao Dictionary include: - Multilingual word lookup and full-text translation in Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and French - Original "online definitions" feature, easily covering new and hot internet words - Local Chinese-English vocabulary of 100,000 common words - 23 million massive example sentences, including authentic examples from well-known English media - Support pronunciation of words and example sentences, experience pure English pronunciation - Convenient multi-platform synchronized wordbook, learn words anytime and anywhere - Rich Chinese encyclopedia, providing a one-stop knowledge query platform.

App.Name: Tianyi
App.Description: The "Tianyi" app is an MBAE (Mobile Broadband User Experience) app launched by China Telecom for users. "Tianyi" provides mobile broadband users with personal account information inquiries and convenient recharge and subscription services. Some functions of this app require inserting a China Telecom internet card device and connecting to the China Telecom 3G network before use!

App.Name: Cut the Rope
App.Description: Cut the Rope is a physics puzzle game officially released by ZeptoLab, launched on the Windows 8 app store in November 2012. The app uses the new Windows UI design and has vivid and cute cartoon animations that intuitively display fun level scenes. The app supports a large number of levels, provides various mechanisms and props, and its core function is cutting ropes and collecting stars to guide candy into the little monster Om Nom's mouth. You can experience realistic physics collision effects and unlock new themed levels. The app supports touch operation, some levels are free to download, and it is compatible with Windows 8 touch devices, bringing a relaxed and fun puzzle game experience.

App.Name: Where's My Water?
App.Description: Where's My Water is a physics puzzle game officially released by Disney, launched on the Windows 8 app store in December 2012. The app uses the new Windows UI design and has vivid and smooth water flow animations that intuitively display underground pipe level scenes. The app supports hundreds of fun levels and provides various elements such as mud, toxic water, and steam. Its core function is digging through soil to guide water flow, avoiding various dangerous substances, and delivering clean water to the little crocodile's bathtub. You can unlock hidden levels and extra story content. The app is perfectly adapted for touch operation and supports Windows 8 touch devices, bringing a brain-teasing and fun puzzle game experience.

App.Name: Adobe Photoshop Express
App.Description: Adobe Photoshop Express is a simple photo editing app officially released by Adobe, launched on the Windows 8 app store in May 2013. It uses the Windows UI interface and is compatible with mouse and touch operation. It supports image cropping, straightening and rotation, comes with one-click automatic optimization, allows manual adjustment of exposure, contrast, and color temperature saturation, and can remove red-eye defects from photos. It includes multiple free filters and frames, editing operations support undo, saving images does not directly overwrite the original, and after editing you can directly save and export. It is used for completing simple daily photo adjustment processing.

App.Name: AC SUDOKU
App.Description: AC Sudoku is a Sudoku game client on the Windows 8 platform focused on classic logic and brain training. It provides players with a massive number of Sudoku puzzles from beginner to expert levels, paired with a fresh visual style and smooth operating experience, allowing Sudoku enthusiasts to enjoy the fun of reasoning anytime and anywhere. The app interface uses the modern design language of Windows 8 and supports snapped display, allowing players to quickly preview the daily challenge and game progress on the Start screen. Through difficulty levels, note mode, and smart hint features, both beginners and veteran players can find a pace that suits them. AC Sudoku is not only a casual entertainment tool but also a good partner for exercising thinking and improving concentration, helping everyone calm down in a fast-paced life and enjoy the sense of achievement brought by each numerical reasoning challenge.

App.Name: Survivalcraft
App.Description: You are stranded on the shore of an infinite block world. Explore, mine resources, craft tools and weapons, build traps, and plant plants. Dress yourself up and hunt animals for food and resources. Build shelters to survive cold nights and share your world online. Ride horses, camels, or drive axles, and lead a herd of cattle to protect them from predators. Blast rocks to open roads. Build complex electrical devices. In this long-running sandbox survival and building game series, the possibilities are endless.
In this long-running sandbox survival and building game series, the possibilities are endless.

App.Description: Relive the classic Minecraft PE era on your Windows device! Version 0.15.0 (the Friendly Update) brings Realms support, horses, leads, name tags, strays and husks, pig riding, and new jungle temples. App.Description: Remote Desktop is a system component developed by Microsoft and a remote connection feature in the Windows series of operating systems, using a graphical interface to achieve remote control of computers. Remote Desktop projects the operating environment of a remote computer through a visual interface, supporting localized operations such as real-time software installation and program execution.

App.Name: Zootopia
App.Description: Zootopia Crime Files is a hidden object puzzle game officially released by Disney, launched on the Windows 8.1 app store in June 2016. It uses the Windows UI interface, and both mouse and touch can be used. Players follow Judy and Nick to handle various cases, search for hidden clues at crime scenes, and go to the lab to analyze collected evidence. The game recreates many classic scenes from Zootopia, allows calling other police station characters to assist in handling cases, and uses character-specific abilities to advance levels and unlock different case storylines. It has multiple themed maps and a large number of levels. Clearing levels collects stars, and completing tasks earns medals to unlock levels. For users who like making screenshots, preserving memories, or doing creative editing, Video to Photo provides an efficient and stable solution. It is a tool that combines practicality and ease of use.

The game uses cartoonish graphics and relaxing music, testing both the player's precision and providing entertainment. In addition to basic gameplay, obstacles and special levels are added, increasing challenge and fun. Shuffle Party makes full use of the advantages of touch operation, letting players experience the fun of competition through easy sliding. It is one of the popular casual titles on Windows 8.

App.Name: Drawboard PDF Editor

It is known for its intuitive touch and handwriting experience, especially suitable for use with touch devices such as Surface. Users can highlight, annotate, draw, and even sign PDF documents with smooth and natural operation. Compared with traditional PDF readers, Drawboard PDF emphasizes interactivity and productivity, helping students, engineers, designers, and professionals efficiently handle documents. Its modern interface and rich features make it an ideal choice for Windows users for PDF editing and annotation.

App.Name: DrawPlan

It provides users with an intuitive interface and diverse drawing tools, suitable for house design, floor planning, or creative sketches. The app supports multi-layer graphic editing, and users can easily draw lines and shapes and add annotations to quickly complete design ideas. Compared with traditional drawing software, DrawPlan emphasizes simplicity and ease of use, allowing non-professional users to get started quickly. It provides users in the Windows ecosystem with an efficient way to visualize planning, combining practicality and creativity.

App.Name: Compass+

It combines a simple modern interface with precise direction guidance, helping users quickly obtain direction information in daily life or outdoor activities. The app supports multiple display modes, including traditional compass view and digital angle display, making it convenient for users in different scenarios. The design of Compass+ emphasizes ease of use and stability, allowing users to easily grasp direction. Whether traveling, hiking, or for daily navigation, it can provide reliable assistance.

App.Name: Puzzles
App.Description: Puzzles is a casual puzzle app released by Jujuba Software on the Windows platform. It provides users with rich puzzle gameplay, covering multiple difficulty levels and image themes, suitable for players of different ages. The app interface is simple and intuitive, and the operation is close to the real puzzle experience. Users can complete patterns by dragging puzzle pieces. In addition to the traditional puzzle mode, it also supports custom image import, allowing players to turn their own photos into puzzle challenges. Puzzles can not only exercise observation and patience but also bring a relaxed entertainment experience. It is one of the puzzle games loved by Windows users.

App.Name: Adobe Content Viewer
App.Description: Adobe Content Viewer is a digital publication preview tool officially released by Adobe, launched on the Windows 8.1 app store in 2014. It uses Windows UI design and supports mouse and touch operation. It is specifically used to open interactive digital publications created with InDesign and Digital Publishing Suite. It can preview PDF, JPEG, PNG, and HTML publication content, supporting interactive elements such as hyperlinks, slideshows, scrolling frames, web embeds, video, and audio. It has three play modes: element creation, quest adventure, and parkour battle. You can breed different kinds of dragons, play as a knight or sorcerer to start story quests, and control characters to fight monsters and bosses. Completing synthesis and quests triggers fun text prompts. It is compatible with Windows 8 and suitable for experiencing relaxed fantasy puzzle adventure.

Players experience the complete vegetable garden labor process: turning soil, sowing seeds, watering, caring for various vegetables, and harvesting crops when they mature. Harvested fruits and vegetables can be sold to animal customers. The game has simple operation, cartoonish and soft art style, and no complex difficulty, suitable for young children to experience the fun of growing vegetables.

Children can complete various small tasks in the supermarket, helping animal customers find products, weighing fruits and vegetables, organizing shelves, and tidying shopping carts, and can also operate the checkout counter. It includes more than ten supermarket-themed mini-games, with no complex text, cartoonish art style, and no ads or in-app purchases. It is suitable for experiencing daily supermarket life and exercising simple classification and counting cognition.

Through their cooperation, players can freely create their own world. Toca Builders emphasizes open-ended gameplay with no fixed goals, encouraging children to use their imagination and creativity. Its cartoonish graphics and relaxed atmosphere make the building process both fun and educational. It is an excellent work of learning through play.

App.Name: Toca Hair Salon 2
