The core gameplay is letting children freely explore and interact in a virtual "salon" environment. Players can design looks for characters, try different hairstyles and outfits, and even create exaggerated and funny styles. It has no fixed goals or restrictions, emphasizing open-ended gameplay and encouraging children to use their imagination and creativity. Its cartoonish graphics and relaxed atmosphere make Toca Salon a work of learning through play, bringing joy while also cultivating aesthetics and creativity.

App.Name: Where's My Water? Featuring XYY
App.Description: Where's My Water? is a classic casual puzzle game released by Disney and is also popular on the Windows platform. The protagonist is a cute crocodile who loves taking baths, but the water flow is always blocked by various obstacles. Players need to draw lines, dig through soil, or trigger mechanisms to let clean water flow smoothly into the bathtub. The level design is ingenious, testing both logical thinking and certain operational skills. Cartoonish graphics and relaxing music make the whole process full of fun and challenge. Where's My Water? is not only entertaining but also helps cultivate players' puzzle-solving abilities.

App.Name: Hearts
App.Description: Hearts is a classic card game that has long been popular as a built-in entertainment item on the Windows platform. The rules are simple but full of strategy: players need to avoid collecting heart cards and the Queen of Spades, as these cards add points, and the goal is to keep the lowest score. Each game usually involves four players taking turns playing cards, testing players' judgment and skill. The Windows version of Hearts not only provides an intuitive interface but also allows playing against computer AI, letting users experience the fun and challenge of card games in leisure time.

App.Name: Nook eBook Reader
App.Description: Nook Book Reader is an e-book reading app released by Barnes & Noble on the Windows platform. It provides users with access to the Nook store and supports purchasing, downloading, and reading a rich variety of e-book resources. The app interface is simple and supports font size adjustment, night mode, and bookmark functionality, making it convenient for users to customize the reading experience according to personal habits. In addition to basic reading functions, Nook Book Reader also emphasizes cross-device synchronization, allowing users to continue reading seamlessly between different devices. For users who enjoy digital reading, it is a tool that combines convenience and practicality.

App.Name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
App.Description: GTA: San Andreas is a classic action-adventure game released by Rockstar Games and is also very popular on the Windows platform. The game is set in the fictional state of San Andreas, and players play as protagonist CJ, exploring the three cities of Los Santos, San Fierro, and Las Venturas. It combines an open world, story missions, and free exploration. Players can drive vehicles, participate in gang conflicts, and experience rich side activities. The gameplay is similar to Tetris but emphasizes balance and structural design: blocks must be placed reasonably to remain stable and continuously extend upward. The game includes multiple challenge modes, such as timed building or specific height goals, testing players' spatial thinking while also providing a relaxed entertainment experience. Cartoonish graphics and fun sound effects make Throne Together one of the representative casual titles of the Windows 8 era.

App.Name: Farming Simulator 14
App.Description: Farming Simulator 14 is a classic farm management simulation game released by Giants Software and is very popular on the Windows platform and mobile devices. Players play as a farmer, managing land, planting crops, raising livestock, and using various agricultural machines to complete tasks such as plowing, harvesting, and transportation. The game provides a realistic agricultural machinery operation experience, including tractors, combine harvesters, and transport trucks. Players can gradually expand the farm scale and improve production efficiency. Compared with previous titles, Farming Simulator 14 has optimizations in graphics and controls, making it smoother and more realistic. It is suitable for players who like simulation management and agricultural themes.

App.Name: Pong8

Players can control the paddle through touch or keyboard to compete against the computer or other players. The game has a brisk pace and simple rules, but requires certain reaction speed and operational skills to win. Compared with traditional Pong-style games, Pong8 has upgrades in visual presentation and gameplay details, bringing a smoother experience. It is a lightweight title suitable for quick entertainment.

App.Name: Game Dev Tycoon Lite

The Lite version usually includes some features and levels, allowing players to experience the core gameplay: choosing themes, developing games, releasing works, and observing market feedback.
